execution.description: Ran the battery_level4 attack adapter (the proposal's §8 suite) against Carbon's real Level 4 gates: G3 strict parse, G4 validate with fixture caps, and rebuild.

expected: Every malformed graph document would be refused before execution, with a typed construction refusal.
observed: A document whose declared node shape lied (a tanh output declared [4, 3]) passed G4. It failed only when executed, which would have been inside G6 training, untyped and after compute was spent. Every other attack was held.
keep: Check declared metadata against derived metadata before execution. G4 now evaluates the rebuilt graph abstractly (jax.eval_shape: shapes only, no compile, no data) and refuses with declared_aval_mismatch.
Keep the declared_shape_lie specimen in the §8 suite with an unchecked-gate control that fires, so that a regression is caught.
change: Treat every Level 4 field that is declared rather than derived as an attack surface: derive it, then compare, before any compute.
